title: Return potential (cohort median alpha)
mechanism: Expected alpha vs analogs: the median 3y/1y from-listing alpha of similar past IPOs, scaled 0-100.
verdict: Predicts in both eras; positive cross-regime rank-IC. Carries weight in the combined score.
existence: Cross-regime rank-IC positive in both eras (boom and longterm).

title: Multibagger odds (% analogs 2x/5x)
mechanism: Share of analog cohort that reached 2x/5x. Score anchored to endpoint-2x rate (keeps validated weights/OOS valid).
verdict: Positive rank-IC in both eras. P(EVER 2x) also reported alongside endpoint-2x (the gap = the timing/exit tax, e.g. MB analog 18.8% ended 2x vs 37.5% ever touched 2x).

title: Downside safety (inverse wipeout/below-issue/deep-DD)
mechanism: 100*(1 - risk blend) of the analog cohort: inverse of wipeout, below-issue and deep-drawdown rates.
verdict: Strongest, most consistent positive rank-IC in both eras; highest data-informed weight.

title: Crowded IPO window (ctx_ipo_heat_90d)
mechanism: Count of IPOs in the prior 90 days. Crowded windows split a finite retail wallet and drag forward 1-year alpha.
verdict: FOLDED into the data-informed score after passing the OOS fold gate (5/5 splits improved, +10..+56pp). NEGATIVE in all 4 regime cells (rank-IC -0.13..-0.26; top-vs-bottom tercile alpha -16 to -29pp). Robust both eras, both boards.
existence: Negative in all 4 cells; OOS fold test passed 5/5 splits.
playbook: Crowded prior-90d IPO window = caution / lower score.

title: Wipeout-safety (own validated red flags -> return)
mechanism: Component = 100 - 50*(validated flag count) on the query's OWN pre-listing features (tiny-sales, loss-making, obscure-banker).
verdict: The FIRST signal to earn its way in under 'evolve-only-if-robust' (folded 2026-06-02, user-approved). Cross-regime rank-IC boom .080 / long .048 -> weight 0.13. OOS RE-VALIDATED after wiring: 3y lift 55->77pp, 1y +1.9->+3.6pp, +5.0pp on the other cutoff.
existence: OOS re-validated across all splits after wiring.
playbook: More validated pre-listing red flags -> lower score. Presets keep weight 0; only data_informed profile uses it.

title: Wipeout red-flag badge (tiny-sales, loss-making, obscure-banker)
mechanism: Pre-listing flags: tiny pre-IPO sales (<25cr), loss-making at IPO (PAT<=0), obscure banker. Additive count sorts bad-outcome rate.
verdict: Validated pre-listing flags, partial cross-regime. Additive red-flag count sorts SME-boom bad-outcome 14.6% -> 46.4%. Shown as a prominent WIPEOUT badge.
playbook: Show the badge; more flags = higher wipeout risk.
failure_cells: boom/MB names too young to die; high-debt/accrual/valuation not robust.

title: Disposition contagion (cold tape vs hot chase)
mechanism: Prior cohort's realized listing pops drive the next cohort's retail demand AND forward alpha; IPOs braving a cold streak are demand-validated and outperform.
verdict: VALIDATED CROSS-REGIME (4/4 cells, +2.6..+18.2pp) + OOS-directional. Cold-tape listers beat hot-chase at 3m. Demand chase IC(trailing pops, retail sub)=+0.454; tax IC(trailing pops, fwd alpha_3m | Nifty-controlled)=-0.088.
existence: OOS directional (cold n=57; post-2022 mostly hot tape).
playbook: Hot tape = wait; cold tape = engage. Display-only regime read.
failure_cells: Fold test 1/5 splits -> NOT in score (3m timing signal, 1y/3y selection horizons don't capture it; crowded_window holds the long-horizon climate seat).

title: Capitulation flag (never closed above issue, d1-90)
mechanism: Anchor decay: if a stock never closes above its adjusted issue price in trading days 1-90, it has entered a capitulation regime with elevated wipeout/dead-money.
verdict: VALIDATED CROSS-REGIME, NO LOOK-AHEAD (knowable at day 90). Flag-rate 12% (n=261/2174). Bad-outcome rate 55% vs 13% without. INCREMENTAL to N14 flags at every count (+39/+44/+45pp). Post-flag fwd-1y alpha negative in all 4 cells. Display-only red flag.
existence: No-look-ahead test: forward 1y alpha measured from d91 (after flag knowable); negative gap in all 4 cells.
playbook: Day-90 portfolio checkpoint: still below issue after 90 days = exit review, alongside the N14 badge.
failure_cells: boom/MB bad-outcome cell immature (too young to die). NOT a pre-listing score input (post-listing signal).

title: Early corp-action euphoria tell (bonus/split in yr 1)
mechanism: A bonus/split with ex-date 30-365d after listing follows a huge run-up and marks the euphoric TOP, not a healthy company.
verdict: VALIDATED-THIN (n=31): bonus/split after a median +184% run-up then CRASH. Fwd-3m alpha after ex-date -22.2% win 16% vs matched controls +2.2% win 55%. Not run-up mean-reversion (timing-dose null). Endpoint alpha_1y still +12.8% (marks the top, not a bad company). Display-only EXIT flag.
existence: Matched pseudo-event controls (same type, run-up +-25pp); timing-dose null.
playbook: Early bonus/split after a big run-up = sell signal.
failure_cells: N too thin for score entry; revisit as sample grows.

title: Month-1 path asymmetry (path_ratio_1m persistence)
mechanism: Month-1 up/down asymmetry (mfe/|mae| from listing) predicts the full year: a strong, shallow first month -> hold; a weak, deep one -> the year rarely recovers.
verdict: ROBUST CONDITIONING (not in score, post-listing info). Predicts the full year in all 4 cells (IC +0.23..+0.49, ~51pp tercile spread). The persistence rule made tradable for hold/exit decisions.
existence: All 4 cells same sign; effect size far exceeds the mechanical month-1-inside-1y overlap.
playbook: Strong shallow first month -> hold; weak deep first month -> exit (the year rarely recovers).
failure_cells: Overlap caveat: month 1 is inside the 1y window. Post-listing info only; never the pre-IPO score.

title: Tradeable upside (P cohort ever reached +30%)
mechanism: Movement-lens (MFE-based) component: probability the analog cohort ever touched +30%.
verdict: Predicts (.14/.07) BUT adding it CUT the 3y OOS lift 55.1->47.4pp (redundant with multibagger) -> not robust -> weight 0, display-only. Shown with the capture gap.
existence: Failed the robustness gate (cut OOS lift).
playbook: Shown with capture gap; not in the combined blend.

title: Liquidity (% investable analogs)
mechanism: Realizability: share of analog cohort that is investable/tradeable.
verdict: IC .04/.05 boom, -.01 longterm -> flips sign -> no signal. Weight 0.

title: Quality (query's own fundamentals)
mechanism: The query IPO's own profitable/ROE/D-E/margin profile scaled 0-100.
verdict: IC -.02/-.04 boom, .01/.07 longterm -> no signal. The cohort-derived components predict; the query's OWN fundamentals don't. Weight 0.
failure_cells: Query's own fundamentals carry no cross-regime signal.

title: GMP-surprise residual (listed above/below GMP-implied)
mechanism: Listing above/below what GMP implied (the residual) -> does the surprise direction carry 1w/1m drift?
verdict: Weak lean (+0.048 after pop control; Q1 -7.9% vs Q5 -2.7%). Display-watch only.

title: PE-vs-sector mean-reversion
mechanism: PE normalized by sector median, tertiled: expensive-vs-sector names mean-revert (lower forward alpha).
verdict: MB-only LEAN-NEGATIVE (IC -0.10/-0.21, -43pp tercile spread in the 2 cells where PE exists). SME has no PE data -> blocked. Re-test if SME PE ever lands.
existence: Lean-negative in the 2 MB cells with PE data.
failure_cells: No SME PE data -> cannot validate cross-regime.

title: QIB-vs-retail demand ratio
mechanism: QIB/retail subscription ratio: institutions-over-retail demand is mildly good.
verdict: LEAN-POSITIVE (+0.05/+0.07/+0.08 in 3 cells). Display-only candidate at best; not folded.

title: (note) F5e is display-only, not in score
mechanism: Capitulation is a day-90 post-listing monitoring flag.
verdict: F5e capitulation, though validated, is display-only per the score policy because it is a post-listing signal (not a pre-listing score input). See f5e_capitulation for the numbers.
playbook: Day-90 checkpoint flag, not a score input.

title: Anchor lock-in unlock dip (day-30 / day-90)
mechanism: SEBI anchor lock-in (50% @30d + 50% @90d post-2022-04) should create an abnormal alpha dip proportional to anchor share, buyable.
verdict: FALSIFIED - placebo inverted. Treatment (post-2022, n=279) W90 median CAR +0.10%, P(neg)=48%, dose-response +0.058 (WRONG sign). Placebo pre-2022 (no day-90 tranche, n=144) W90 -1.16% (MORE negative than treatment). Buy-the-dip loses (38% win, median -2.9%). No Indian replication of the US lockup effect.
existence: Placebo inverted; natural experiment failed completely.
do_not_retest: Field & Hanka US lockup-expiry effect does not replicate for Indian anchor unlocks at day 90/30. Calendar = information only, no edge.

title: Within-cluster neglected-member catch-up (owner's pattern)
mechanism: Within a cluster of overlapping subscription windows, GMP-rank winners pop then bleed while neglected members outperform week-1 to 1m.
verdict: FALSIFIED. Hot members pop more (-0.49, mechanical) but neglected members show ZERO forward catch-up: IC(rank, fwd alpha_1m | cluster) = +0.005/-0.003/-0.002 at W=3/5/7. Robust null across the sweep.
existence: Robust null across the cluster-width sweep.
do_not_retest: No forward catch-up for neglected cluster members.

title: Listing-order tone-setting
mechanism: The first lister's day-1 sets later cluster members' opens (contagion).
verdict: REJECTED. Raw spill +0.248 collapses to +0.048 after controlling own GMP -> shared hype, not contagion.
do_not_retest: Apparent tone-setting is shared GMP/hype, not contagion.

title: Ordinal demand fatigue in rapid streaks
mechanism: The Nth IPO in a rapid streak pops less as the wallet fatigues.
verdict: MECHANISM-ONLY, no trade. Demand-side signature real on SME (retail -0.226 vs QIB -0.137 - the wallet mechanism shows) but no consistent price edge; MB weak.
existence: Demand signature present (SME) but no price edge.
do_not_retest: Mechanism confirmation only; no tradable price edge.

title: Retail congestion tax (mechanism)
mechanism: Concurrent open issue-size depresses RETAIL subscription but not QIB; supports the crowded_window signal.
verdict: MECHANISM CONFIRMATION (not a standalone trade). Retail -0.197 vs QIB +0.056 - the predicted asymmetry confirmed. Supports crowded_window; the hidden-quality trade leg is untested.
do_not_retest: Mechanism only; folded effect already captured by crowded_window.

title: Regime-gated junk bounce + conditional take-profit
mechanism: Low-quality x BULL listing regime -> rentable 1-month MFE (sell-into-strength works there); same junk in bear dies on arrival.
verdict: FALSIFIED twice. Wave-1a (demand proxy): junk x bull did NOT out-peak junk x non-bull (MB 9.7% vs 13.3% month-1 MFE, opposite; SME flat); placebo (200x shuffle) fails p95; TP deltas ~0. Wave-2 PIT re-test: bull-gate FLIPS across cohorts (boom bull>bear; longterm bear>bull); terminal alpha negative everywhere (-5..-10%). Closed.
existence: Placebo failed both segments; PIT re-test confirmed not cross-regime.
do_not_retest: Bull-gate flips across cohorts; junk terminal alpha negative everywhere. One permitted PIT re-test already done and confirmed the rejection.

title: Bear-window stop-loss
mechanism: Maybe stops only lose in bull eras; test stops ONLY in bear-during-window cohorts (2008/2011/2022).
verdict: REJECTED. Stops LOSE even in bear windows: SL12 -12.0% / SL20 -9.1% vs buy-and-hold -5.8%. The no-stop-loss truth is now unconditional AND conditional.
existence: Stops underperform hold even in bears.
do_not_retest: Stops lose in every regime, including bear windows.

title: Issue-price magnet (breakeven selling wall)
mechanism: Approach-from-below stalls at the issue price (a breakeven selling wall) vs placebo levels.
verdict: FALSIFIED BY PLACEBO. 4472 episodes: issue level clear 33%/reject 65%, placebo 0.90x level 37%/62% - identical. No breakeven-anchor magnet. Dose runs OPPOSITE (deep approaches clear MORE, 41% vs 29% - momentum). Touch-buy = dead money (median fwd-10d -2.1%, win 40%).
existence: Placebo identical to the real level; dose inverted.
do_not_retest: Any overhead level rejects weak stocks; the issue price per se carries nothing.

title: Listing-day-high breakout trade
mechanism: Listing-day-high = trapped-supply ceiling; a CONFIRMED breakout should accelerate, touch-and-fail should weaken.
verdict: REJECTED. Confirmed breakouts show NO acceleration (fwd-20d -1.1%, win 47%). METHOD TRAP CAUGHT: the touch-and-fail cohort (-39.6%, win 3%) is LOOK-AHEAD-classified (knowing it never confirms uses the future) -> descriptive only, never tradable.
existence: No acceleration on confirmed breakouts; fail-classification is look-ahead.
do_not_retest: Breakouts don't accelerate; the contrast was a look-ahead artifact.

title: Volume-confirmed reclaim
mechanism: Volume-confirmed crossings of a reference level beat naked ones (accumulation).
verdict: INVERTED as a buy signal. Confirmed crossings hold better 5d (58% vs 48%) but fwd-10d alpha is WORSE (-3.0% vs -1.4%) - reclaim-day volume spike = distribution, not accumulation.
do_not_retest: Reclaim-day volume marks distribution, not accumulation.

title: Double-reference ordering (reclaim issue then clear LDH)
mechanism: Reclaiming the issue price first raises the odds of clearing the listing-day-high later.
verdict: MECHANICAL/CONFOUNDED. Reclaimed-issue-by-d60 -> 57% clear LDH by d120 vs 15% never-reclaimed - but mostly 'weak stocks stay weak' + the path constraint (must pass issue to reach LDH). Descriptive only.
existence: Confounded by weak-stocks-stay-weak and path constraint.
do_not_retest: Mechanical/confounded; F5a's placebo shows levels per se carry nothing.

title: Round-number issue prices = stronger magnets
mechanism: Round-number issue prices act as stronger psychological magnets.
verdict: NULL. Stall/clear/reject flat across round-number tiers (36/35/32% clear).
do_not_retest: No round-number magnet effect.

title: GMP x retail-share interaction
mechanism: GMP is self-fulfilling only when the GMP-watching crowd (retail) is the marginal buyer.
verdict: NO interaction (IC 0.643 vs 0.670) - GMP transmits to the pop regardless of buyer mix.
do_not_retest: GMP transmits regardless of retail share.

title: GMP meaning by regime (sign flip)
mechanism: GMP means froth in hot markets, scarcity in cold -> its forward sign should flip by regime.
verdict: NO sign flip (hot +0.06, cold -0.01; both ~0).
do_not_retest: GMP's forward signal is ~0 in both regimes.

title: T+3 listing natural experiment (GMP->pop tightening)
mechanism: Mandatory T+3 listing (2023-12) should have tightened the GMP->pop transmission vs T+6.
verdict: FALSIFIED. Transmission got LOOSER post-T+3 (IC 0.626->0.604; |error| 11.1->14.8pp) - opposite of hypothesis (2024-25 frenzy confound noted).
do_not_retest: T+3 did not tighten transmission (confounded by 2024-25 frenzy).

title: Unfilled-demand day-1 pressure
mechanism: Day-1 buying proportional to how much the allotment lottery denied (sub-1 = unfilled multiple), incremental to raw subscription.
verdict: INVERTED. Undersubscribed names are simply worse (fwd -6.5% vs -2.6%); junk signal dominates clean-float mechanics. n=140 (boom-MB 27, thin as predicted).
do_not_retest: Unfilled-demand inverts; undersubscribed = worse, not pent-up.

title: Sector copycat decay (Nth same-sector IPO worse)
mechanism: The Nth same-sector IPO in 12 months is progressively worse (copycat fatigue).
verdict: REJECTED. IC -0.012; pioneers -13.1% vs 4th+ -10.8% - no decay (slightly opposite).
do_not_retest: No sector-copycat decay.

title: Size-weighted retail-P&L climate index
mechanism: An outcome-based, size-weighted climate gauge to refine/replace count-based crowded_window heat.
verdict: WORSE than simple median-pop climate (IC -0.02/-0.03 vs -0.09); median-pop (= F7's basis) is the best climate gauge. Size-weighting rejected.
do_not_retest: Size-weighting adds nothing; median-pop climate is best.

title: F7 climate component fold test (does it enter the score?)
mechanism: Trailing median-pop climate component (cold->high) folded into the selection score.
verdict: Does NOT enter the score. Improved OOS top-quintile lift in only 1/5 splits (max +0.1). F7 is a short-horizon (3m) timing signal; 1y/3y selection horizons don't capture it. Score remains 8 components. (F7 itself stays VALIDATED display.)
do_not_retest: 3m signal; selection horizons (1y/3y) don't capture it; crowded_window already holds the long-horizon climate seat.

title: Pre-IPO-holder 6-month unlock dip (day-180)
mechanism: Pre-IPO holders' 6-month lock-in (post-Aug-2021) should create a buyable supply dip ~day-180 (vs ~day-365 before).
verdict: WEAK/NOT TRADEABLE. Crossed design half-works: pre-Aug-2021 cohort dips at its 1y unlock (W365 -1.94%, 60% neg), clean at placebo W180 (+0.54%); but post-2021 dips at BOTH windows (-0.82%/-1.02%), so attribution is unclean; magnitude ~1-2% over 12 trading days ~= costs.
do_not_retest: ~1-2% over 12 days, below costs; consistent-with-mechanism but not tradeable.

title: First-week tape x regime (head-fake)
mechanism: A strong first week in a bear market is a head-fake; tape x regime should gate the hold horizon.
verdict: NO gate. bull -8.5% vs bear -10.0%.
do_not_retest: First-week tape x regime carries no edge.

title: Regime-transition fragility
mechanism: IPOs listed in a bull that then turns should break the persistence rule (fragile).
verdict: NONE detected. +6.5% vs +6.9% (transition n=22, thin).
do_not_retest: No transition fragility (thin n=22).

title: Drawdown-recovery odds by listing cycle-phase
mechanism: Late-bull listings don't get dip-bought -> lower drawdown-recovery odds.
verdict: NO phase effect on recovery odds: 20%/16%/21% across phases.
do_not_retest: Recovery odds flat across cycle phase.

title: Same-banker scheduling collision
mechanism: A lead manager running two issues close together splits its attention/placement capacity.
verdict: NULL: -4.5% vs -5.2% (also null under congestion control).
do_not_retest: No same-banker collision effect.

title: ASBA refund echo (freed money pumps the open book)
mechanism: Money freed by IPO A's ASBA unblock (~T+2) flows into the still-open book B.
verdict: OPPOSITE of pump: IC -0.179. Concurrent unblocking = congestion drag, not an echo. Consistent with the F2d retail-congestion-tax mechanism.
do_not_retest: ASBA echo is a congestion drag, not a pump.

title: Day-1 flipping proxy
mechanism: High day-1 turnover (volume/shares-offered + day1->5 reversal) = flipping churn -> long-run underperformance.
verdict: INVERTED. High day-1 turnover -> BETTER alpha (IC +0.103 on 1y, pop-controlled; Q5 -14.5% vs Q1 -30.2%; placebo day-20 turnover clean at -0.009). Day-1 volume is a DEMAND signal, not flipping churn.
do_not_retest: Day-1 turnover is a demand signal (better outcomes), not flipping. Inversion noted as display-context.

title: SME circuit-cage path signature
mechanism: SME circuit limits cage price discovery, producing timing differences vs MB for the same shock.
verdict: INCONSISTENT. SME peaks LATER on small moves (11 vs 8d) but EARLIER on big moves (40 vs 52d) - no consistent signature.
do_not_retest: No consistent circuit-cage timing signature.

title: Market momentum at listing (ctx_nifty_mom_3m)
mechanism: The market's recent 3-month direction at listing should color the IPO's later alpha.
verdict: REJECTED. IC ~= 0 in all 4 cells (-0.03..+0.03). Market direction says nothing about the IPO's later alpha.
do_not_retest: No link between market momentum and IPO forward alpha.

title: Recent-pop heat (ctx_heat_pop_90d)
mechanism: How hot recent listing pops were (prior 90d) should predict forward alpha.
verdict: REJECTED (not robust). Sign flips by segment (MB boom +0.13, SME boom -0.17).
do_not_retest: Sign-unstable across segments.

title: Sector heat (ctx_sector_heat_180d)
mechanism: Recent same-sector IPO heat (prior 180d) should predict forward alpha.
verdict: REJECTED (not robust). Sign flips by era (boom +, longterm -).
do_not_retest: Sign-unstable across eras.

title: Gold / silver / crude / rupee macro context
mechanism: Commodity/FX macro context at listing might color IPO outcomes.
verdict: EXCLUDED by design decision. Weak general link; new source maintenance cost; revisit only sector-conditionally.
do_not_retest: Excluded by design; revisit only sector-conditionally.

title: SHORT score (GMP + subscription percentiles)
mechanism: A demand-percentile (GMP + subscription) score to predict a short-horizon pop / month-1 +25% touch.
verdict: NO TRADABLE EDGE. Train: P(touch +25% m1) rises only 33%->39% low->high (a sliver) while the HIGH-short bucket's 1y median is NEGATIVE (-3.4% vs +7.1% low). 2026 holdout noisy/inverted (37% vs 32%, high n=2). The existing LONG score is the better short-horizon predictor (holdout 1m -7.7%/+2.9%/+6.7%).
existence: Sliver on train, inverted on the 2026 holdout.
do_not_retest: No separate short-game model is supported; the LONG quality score is the better short-horizon predictor. Re-test when 2026 cohort matures.

title: Hot IPOs pop then fade (flip-the-hot edge)
mechanism: Hot first-month pops should fade -> a contrarian flip-the-hot-ones edge.
verdict: NOT SUPPORTED - the opposite holds. Early strength PERSISTS: MB cold(<+5%) ends year -11.0% vs hot(25-60%) +13.9% vs blazing +52.7%; SME cold -15.1% vs hot +29.8% vs blazing +81.9%. Drift after month 1 ~= flat; P(1y below 1m) ~= coin flip.
existence: Opposite to hypothesis; early strength persists.
do_not_retest: No flip-the-hot edge; early strength persists, early weakness persists.

title: Pricing-in-band (band position)
mechanism: Where the issue priced within its band (partial-adjustment analog) should predict forward alpha.
verdict: MIXED across regime cells (sign flips) - failed the robustness bar.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells; do not re-test without new evidence.

mechanism: Anchor allocation share / presence of anchors signals institutional conviction.
verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

verdict: MIXED / THIN - failed the robustness bar.

verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.

verdict: MIXED / WEAK. banker_prior_alpha mixed across cells; banker_prior_wipeout directionally negative but weak (-0.0..-0.10) - the binary obscure-banker flag already in-score captures most of it.
existence: Weak/mixed; subsumed by the in-score obscure-banker flag.
do_not_retest: Subsumed by the obscure-banker flag already in-score.

verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.

verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar (see also F8 where undersubscribed simply = worse).

do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Profitable-but-stagnant
mechanism: Profitable companies with no growth may be value traps.
verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Objects-of-issue = debt repayment
mechanism: IPOs raising money to repay debt (vs growth capex) may signal weakness.
verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Listing-day close position (within day-1 range)
mechanism: Where the stock closed within its listing-day range signals day-1 strength.
verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Listing-day green (closed above open)
mechanism: Closing green on listing day signals continued demand.
verdict: MIXED across regime cells - failed the robustness bar.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Listing-day giveback (faded from day-1 high)
mechanism: How much of the day-1 high was given back signals weak hands.
verdict: MIXED signs across cells - rejected.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Early volatility
mechanism: Early post-listing price volatility may predict outcomes.
verdict: MIXED signs across cells - rejected.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Circuit lock (limit-up/down days)
mechanism: Frequency of circuit locks may signal manipulation/illiquidity.
verdict: MIXED signs across cells - rejected.
do_not_retest: Mixed across regime cells.

title: Days-to-peak (1y)
mechanism: How long until the 1y peak - hypothesized as a signal.
verdict: MECHANICAL/descriptive (IC 0.66-0.77): late peak ~= kept rising. Not an ex-ante signal. Confirms 'winners peak late' persistence; rejected as a signal.
do_not_retest: Late peak = kept rising; not knowable ex-ante.

title: Turnover-to-size (lifetime)
mechanism: Lifetime turnover relative to issue size as a liquidity/quality proxy.
verdict: LOOK-AHEAD (IC 0.37-0.65): lifetime turnover = winners stay liquid. Descriptive only; rejected as a signal.
do_not_retest: Lifetime turnover is look-ahead; winners stay liquid.

title: Buy the discount lister (contrarian secondary entry)
mechanism: Buy IPOs that listed at a discount / avoid the hot poppers, as a secondary-buyer edge.
verdict: REJECTED (sign flips by cohort). Listing-day gain carries NO actionable secondary-buyer signal: discount-vs-pop forward returns flip sign across boom/longterm. T3 pop-fade is about the allottee's issue-anchored decay, not a tradable secondary edge.
do_not_retest: Don't pay up to avoid weak listers or chase hot ones - no secondary edge.

title: Micro market-cap as a wipeout flag
mechanism: Tiny market-cap should flag wipeout risk.
verdict: REJECTED - reverse-causation. market_cap_class is CURRENT mcap, so a wipeout reads 'micro' BECAUSE it crashed.
do_not_retest: Current mcap is post-crash; not a pre-listing flag.

title: Low promoter holding as a wipeout flag
mechanism: Low promoter retention should flag risk.
verdict: REJECTED - WRONG sign. High retention = thin illiquid float = the zombie profile, so low holding is not the risk direction.
do_not_retest: High retention (not low) is the zombie/illiquid profile.

title: High GMP as a wipeout flag
mechanism: High grey-market premium hype should flag downside risk.
verdict: REJECTED - WRONG sign. High GMP is PROTECTIVE (hyped names stay liquid; the dead are the unwanted/low-GMP).
do_not_retest: High GMP is protective, not a risk flag.

title: High debt/equity as a wipeout flag
mechanism: High leverage should flag wipeout risk.
verdict: REJECTED as a cross-regime flag - only MB-longterm (N=13); flat on the high-N SME panels. (N7 reports the MB top-debt tertile wipeout 8.9% vs 5.1% as descriptive, not validated.)
existence: Only one thin cell; flat elsewhere.
do_not_retest: Not cross-regime (thin MB-longterm only).

title: Low-debt x high-ROE (clean compounder)
mechanism: Real (not debt-juiced) ROE combined with low leverage = a clean compounder; neither factor alone escapes the deep-negative base.
verdict: VALIDATED (cross-regime, separate layer) - the ONE combination that cleared super-additive + cross-regime + N>=~30/cell (N15). Together they're the best cohort everywhere (MB/longterm base -43% med-alpha -> BOTH +1%; SME/boom -> +91%; multibagger 19% -> 37%). NOT in the score yet (needs OOS-robust to graduate).
playbook: Favor low-debt AND high-ROE together (clean compounder); display, not scored yet.
failure_cells: Neither factor alone escapes the deep-negative base.

title: Any risk-side factor combination
mechanism: Pairs of risk flags should be super-additive (worse together than apart).
verdict: REJECTED (cross-regime). The risk-side hunt found NONE - single wipeout flags are the whole story; pairs overlap or sub-add. high-debt x loss-making is dramatic but longterm-only.
do_not_retest: Single wipeout flags are the whole story; risk pairs overlap/sub-add.

title: Tiny-sales x loss-making interaction
mechanism: Tiny pre-IPO sales combined with loss-making should be super-additively bad.
verdict: SINGLE-REGIME. Clean super-additive in longterm only; the boom verdict was an artifact (loss-making-alone ~= 0% in boom).
existence: Super-additive only in longterm; boom was an artifact.
do_not_retest: Single-regime (longterm only).

title: Buy at listing, hold 1y/3y (secondary)
mechanism: Buy every IPO at listing and hold; the naive secondary-buyer strategy.
verdict: LOSES cross-regime. MB median alpha -16.8% (1y), -51.6% (3y). SME 3y MIXED (boom +6.8% vs longterm -40.9%) - a regime effect, not an edge. Naive IPO-buying doesn't beat the index.
do_not_retest: Naive secondary buy-and-hold loses cross-regime.

title: Secondary + Tier-1 filter (profitable & OFS>=25%)
mechanism: Buy at listing but only profitable issues with OFS>=25% (both pre-listing-known).
verdict: CORRECTED (B/C review): the filter REDUCES the loss (MB 1y mean +5.9% vs -2.3%, median -9.1% vs -16.8%) but median alpha stays NEGATIVE -> still loses cross-regime. The earlier '+28% SME beats do-nothing' was a small-N, single-regime, look-ahead artifact.
existence: Reduces downside but median stays negative.
playbook: Reduces downside, does NOT beat the index.
do_not_retest: Filter reduces loss but doesn't beat the index; the SME win was a look-ahead artifact.

title: Secondary, skip >25% listing pop
mechanism: Buy at listing but skip names that popped more than 25% on listing.
verdict: No improvement over unfiltered secondary_hold; loses cross-regime.
existence: No improvement over the unfiltered baseline.
do_not_retest: Avoiding hot poppers doesn't help; loses cross-regime.

title: Flip at listing (allottee)
mechanism: Allottee sells on listing day to capture the pop.
verdict: The flip myth demolished. Raw median ~= +5-7%, ~70% win - BUT allotment realism + adverse-selection gut the real EV: naive +21% (MB) collapses to +2% after 3.5% median allotment prob + adverse selection.
do_not_retest: Allotment + adverse selection gut the flip EV (~+2%).

title: Take-profit ladder vs buy-and-hold
mechanism: Sell into strength at +20/+50/+100% targets to bank gains.
verdict: Take-profit NEVER beats buy-and-hold cross-regime (0 cells beat hold in BOTH cohorts); capping the upside sacrifices the right tail. Combined TP+SL is NOT backtestable (MFE/MAE can't reveal which fired first - disclosed).
existence: 0 cells beat hold in both cohorts.
do_not_retest: Take-profit caps the right tail; never beats hold cross-regime.

title: Stop-loss (SL-only) vs buy-and-hold
mechanism: Cut losers at a fixed stop to limit drawdown.
verdict: Stop-losses never beat holding cross-regime; tight -10% stops actively HURT the secondary buyer (whipsaw) wherever IPOs show their right tail. The validated truth is the MECHANISM: stops trade the right tail for the body, so they lose where the tail lives (boom both segments + SME) and only beat hold in net-losing tail-less cohorts (MB/longterm). A stop bets this IPO has no right tail.
existence: Never beats hold cross-regime; mechanism validated.
playbook: A stop is a bet that this IPO has no right tail (true for the median name, false for the cohort average).
failure_cells: Loses wherever the right tail lives (boom both segments + SME); only 'wins' in net-losing MB/longterm.
do_not_retest: Stops lose cross-regime; F4 confirmed they lose even in bear windows.

title: Averaging down (buy the dip on a faller)
mechanism: Buy a second tranche after the stock falls -30/-50% to lower the average cost.
verdict: Rarely recovers ('what NOT to do'). Among names that fell to -30/-50% in-horizon, only 4-17% (1y) end back above entry; the 2nd tranche bought at the dip is itself a median LOSER in both cohorts at 1y. The dip is information, not a discount. (SME/boom 3y is the lone winner - boom tide, not robust.)
existence: Dip-buy tranche is a median loser cross-regime.
failure_cells: SME/boom 3y is the lone winner (boom tide, not robust).
do_not_retest: The dip is information, not a discount; averaging down rarely recovers.

title: Partial exit (sell half at +T)
mechanism: Sell half the position at a target to lock gains while keeping upside.
verdict: PARADOX (headline, both cohorts): selling half at +T ALWAYS lifts the MEDIAN but SACRIFICES the MEAN wherever a right tail exists (SME/longterm 3y: median -2%->+22% but mean 104%->79%). A median-vs-mean trade, not a free lunch - converts a tail-harvester into a typical-name harvester.
existence: Median up, mean down wherever a tail exists.
playbook: Sell-half lifts the typical outcome but taxes the tail; choose by goal (median vs mean).
failure_cells: Sacrifices the mean wherever a right tail exists.

title: Fallen-angel recovery (cheap after the fall)
mechanism: Among names down >=-50% in year 1, pre-listing quality (profitable/low-debt/high-ROE) should predict which recover.
verdict: VALIDATED-NULL (cross-regime). Recovery is 16-47% and NO pre-listing feature predicts WHICH recover in a sign-stable way; the one near-stable signal (large fallen issues recover LESS) is the OPPOSITE of the thesis. Negative rule: don't pay up for 'cheap after the fall'.
existence: No pre-listing feature predicts recovery sign-stably.
playbook: Don't pay up for cheap-after-the-fall; recovery is unpredictable.
do_not_retest: Fallen-angel recovery is unpredictable from pre-listing features (validated-null).

title: Listing-pop -> fade gradient
mechanism: A bigger listing pop -> worse subsequent (allottee, issue-anchored) forward return as the pop fades.
verdict: Sign holds in BOTH boom & longterm (cross-regime validated) - but the within-vintage check (2/4 yrs) DOWNGRADED it: not as robust as the 2-bucket check suggested. The allottee-vs-secondary wedge still holds. The fade is a timing/discipline tax on the allottee, not a tradable secondary edge.
playbook: Allottee: the pop fades; don't extrapolate a big pop. Not a secondary-buyer trade.
failure_cells: Within-vintage only 2/4 years; weaker than the 2-bucket view.

title: OFS / skin-in-the-game gradient
mechanism: Lower OFS (more promoter skin in the game) should predict better forward alpha.
verdict: MIXED x-regime. High-OFS-better is a LONGTERM effect that REVERSES in boom (boom -29 vs longterm +48 alpha gradient; boom N=14) -> NOT regime-robust. Don't trust as a standalone signal.
existence: Sign flips across regimes; small N.
do_not_retest: OFS gradient flips sign across regimes (small N); not robust.

title: Profitable-at-IPO premium
mechanism: Companies profitable at IPO should carry a forward-alpha premium.
verdict: MIXED x-regime. Premium sign FLIPS across regimes (boom +20 vs longterm -15, MB; small N 16/11) -> NOT robust in the MB cut. Re-examine with SME + larger N.
existence: Sign flips across regimes; small N.
do_not_retest: Profitable-at-IPO premium flips sign in the MB cut (small N); not robust.

title: Subscription-vs-outcome saturation
mechanism: Subscription demand drives the listing pop but saturates vs forward alpha.
verdict: Reported BOOM-ONLY: demand->listing-pop vs demand->forward-alpha split; saturation test. SINGLE-REGIME (longterm subscription ~= 0) - cannot be cross-validated.

title: Accrual / cash-flow red-flag (PAT>0 but op-cash<=0)
mechanism: Reporting profit while operating cash flow is negative is a hard-to-fake earnings-quality red flag.
verdict: STRONG descriptive signal (reported, not yet cross-regime-validated as a score input): 'PAT>0 but operating cash<=0' underperforms even loss-makers (MB 3y alpha -59% vs -23% clean; wipeout 12.6% vs 6.9%). Batch cf_conversion came out mixed.
existence: Strong in the reported cut; batch cross-regime version mixed.
playbook: Show as an earnings-quality flag; not scored.
